source.oemTestTitle: Ice maker unit and test switch

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the refrigerator before servicing. Wait 3 minutes after unplugging before measuring SMPS terminals (160 Vdc may remain). R-134a sealed-system precautions apply.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing electrical parts.

steps.title: No ice production?
steps.body: LSC27926** models — verify ice maker harness, test switch on ice maker unit, and LCD check region F (ice maker unit).
steps.sourceExcerpt: LSC27926** models — verify ice maker harness, test switch on ice maker unit, and LCD check region F (ice maker unit).

steps.title: Ice maker harness and test switch
steps.body: Verify ice maker connector seating. Press ice maker test switch — ice should eject when kit healthy. Check relays RY4/RY5/RY12.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Verify ice maker connector seating. Press ice maker test switch — ice should eject when kit healthy. Check relays RY4/RY5/RY12.

steps.title: Replace ice maker parts
steps.oemOutcome: Replace ice maker kit, tray sensor, or dispenser relays per §3 troubleshooting.
